value.rationale: Cotangent dimension two is the smallest nontrivial embedding dimension for split local algebras. The theorem gives a complete and characteristic-free recognition criterion for tensor decomposability, identifies the only decomposable normal forms, makes the two truncation exponents intrinsic, and yields the immediate structural consequence that every noncommutative example in this class is indecomposable. This is a natural classification boundary rather than an arbitrary finite slice.
